entries.5acdf6b162e3b887: This is the largest business, manufacturing and selling machine tools (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025: ¥343,277 million).
entries.5cd47b0e0509bc6e: DMG MORI CO., LTD. is a company that makes machine tools such as 5-axis machining centers and multitasking machines, and provides services such as repairs, parts and software around the world in addition to selling machines.
entries.6f515c0a2d79a5b6: This is the largest business, manufacturing and selling machine tools (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025: ¥343,277 million). It produces 5-axis machining machines, multitasking machines, horizontal and vertical machining centers, turning centers, grinding centers, additive manufacturing machines and others. Group companies of DMG MORI AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT in Germany, as well as Taiyo Koki Co., Ltd. and others, are involved in manufacturing and sales.
entries.76fc6faba549d02d: This business provides services and solutions related to machine tools (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025: ¥171,652 million).
entries.9bb53345cfde7401: This business provides services and solutions related to machine tools (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025: ¥171,652 million). It includes MRO (maintenance, repair and overhaul) services such as repair and restoration, spare parts and engineering, as well as the manufacture and sale of measuring devices and software. Magnescale Co., Ltd. handles measuring devices, and DMG MORI Digital Co., Ltd. handles software development and sales.
